text:
incident-bot: PAGE — continuous-batching perf cliff on prod-cluster-3, increased tail latency, KV-cache eviction spike. Pager: @sara oncall. SEV2.

sara: saw the alert, joining. what's the customer impact?

jamie: lots of small requests getting queued, microbatch sizes jumping to 64 then starving downstream. KV cache churn reported from host metrics (evictions/sec >> normal).

mike: looks like prefetch loop caused by recent rollout of adaptive-prefetch v2. Prefetch rate multiplied under high concurrency. KV miss amplifies batch formation.

els: customers complaining about slow responses in chat flows, some timeouts (~2%) on gold-tier. I'm tracking which tenants.

sara: ok plan: 1) roll back adaptive-prefetch v2 on prod-canaries 2) temp constrain microbatch max to 8 3) increase KV retention threshold to avoid cascade evictions 4) notify support/CS. Anyone able to push hotfix?

mike: I can cut the rollback patch and hotfix the config. pushing branch now.

```
# hotfix: reduce microbatch max
microbatch.max = 8
kvcache.eviction_threshold = 0.85  # was 0.6
```

jamie: toggling continuous-batch diagnostic flags to get per-shard queue depth and kv-miss histograms. adding temporary rate limit to incoming prod-gw-6 to blunt surge.

sara: deploy-bot, start canary rollback for adaptive-prefetch v2 on prod-cluster-3 canaries.

deploy-bot: rollback triggered for service/adaptive-prefetch at 1758765448, canary batch 3 -> idle.

mike: hotfix pushed at 1758765465, microbatch cap enforced via config service. Observability: queue depth dropping, KV evictions down 80% within 30s.

jamie: latency P50 -> P99 improving. tail latency still a bit noisy, keeping temporary rate limit for 10m.

els: CS notified, impacted tenant list: 6 mid-market + 2 enterprise (billing & search). ETA to full resolution?

sara: monitor for 15m, if stable we will remove rate limit and fully roll forward to stable. Elaine, please post customer update saying mitigation in place, some requests may have been delayed but no data loss.

mike: adding a follow-up task to revert adaptive-prefetch heuristics and add a safety valve w/ backpressure for high-concurrency scenarios.

jamie: filing postmortem ticket: PM-INC-1758765432, including perf traces and KV histograms. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml for follow-up.

sara: handing off to night oncall @jamie in 10m. if anything flares up ping my phone.

jamie: copy, taking handoff. I'll keep the incident open and update the postmortem with timeline. :thumbsup:
